subject: Higher Mathematics
question: f(x) = \(x^3 + 2x^2 - 15x\) is a polynomial.
parts:
[{"label":"A","letter":"A","text":"If a factor of \(x^3 + ax^2 + 2x + 1\) is \((x + 1)\), then find the value of a.","marks":2,"answer":"Let \(p(x) = x^3 + ax^2 + 2x + 1\)
\((x + 1)\) will be a factor of \(p(x)\) if \(p(-1) = 0\)
\(\therefore p(-1) = (-1)^3 + a(-1)^2 + 2(-1) + 1 = 0\)
or, \(-1 + a - 2 + 1 = 0\)
or, \(a - 2 = 0\)
\(\therefore a = 2\) (Ans.)"},{"label":"B","letter":"B","text":"If f(x) yields the same remainder upon division by \((x - m)\) and \((x - n)\) where \(m \neq n\). Show that, \(m^2 + mn + n^2 + 2m + 2n - 15 = 0\).","marks":4,"answer":"Given, \(f(x) = x^3 + 2x^2 - 15x\)
Remainder when divided by \((x - m)\) is \(f(m) = m^3 + 2m^2 - 15m\)
Remainder when divided by \((x - n)\) is \(f(n) = n^3 + 2n^2 - 15n\)
According to condition, \(f(m) = f(n)\)
\(\therefore m^3 + 2m^2 - 15m = n^3 + 2n^2 - 15n\)
or, \(m^3 - n^3 + 2(m^2 - n^2) - 15(m - n) = 0\)
or, \((m - n)(m^2 + mn + n^2) + 2(m - n)(m + n) - 15(m - n) = 0\)
or, \((m - n)[m^2 + mn + n^2 + 2(m + n) - 15] = 0\)
Since \(m \neq n\), \(m - n \neq 0\), so:
\(m^2 + mn + n^2 + 2m + 2n - 15 = 0\) (Showed)"},{"label":"C","letter":"C","text":"Express \(\frac{x + 2}{f(x)}\) as partial fraction.","marks":4,"answer":"Given, \(f(x) = x^3 + 2x^2 - 15x = x(x^2 + 2x - 15) = x(x + 5)(x - 3)\)
\(\therefore \frac{x + 2}{f(x)} = \frac{x + 2}{x(x + 5)(x - 3)}\)
Let \(\frac{x + 2}{x(x + 5)(x - 3)} = \frac{A}{x} + \frac{B}{x + 5} + \frac{C}{x - 3}\) ... (i)
Multiplying both sides by \(x(x + 5)(x - 3)\),
\(x + 2 = A(x + 5)(x - 3) + Bx(x - 3) + Cx(x + 5)\) ... (ii)
Putting \(x = 0\) in (ii),
\(2 = A(5)(-3) \Rightarrow 2 = -15A \Rightarrow A = -\frac{2}{15}\)
Putting \(x = -5\) in (ii),
\(-5 + 2 = B(-5)(-5 - 3)\)
or, \(-3 = B(-5)(-8) \Rightarrow -3 = 40B \Rightarrow B = -\frac{3}{40}\)
Putting \(x = 3\) in (ii),
\(3 + 2 = C(3)(3 + 5)\)
or, \(5 = C(3)(8) \Rightarrow 5 = 24C \Rightarrow C = \frac{5}{24}\)
Substituting in (i):
\(\frac{x + 2}{x(x + 5)(x - 3)} = \frac{-\frac{2}{15}}{x} + \frac{-\frac{3}{40}}{x + 5} + \frac{\frac{5}{24}}{x - 3}\)
\(= -\frac{2}{15x} - \frac{3}{40(x + 5)} + \frac{5}{24(x - 3)}\) (Ans.)
---"}]

subject: Higher Mathematics
question: P(x) = \(x^3 + 4x^2 + x - 6\) and Q = \(x^3 + y^3 + z^3 - 3xyz\).
parts:
[{"label":"A","letter":"A","text":"For what value of a, (x + 2) will be a factor of the polynomial \(x^2 + 6x - a\)?","marks":2,"answer":"Let \(g(x) = x^2 + 6x - a\)
(x + 2) will be a factor of g(x) if \(g(-2) = 0\).
Now, \(g(-2) = (-2)^2 + 6(-2) - a = 0\)
or, \(4 - 12 - a = 0\)
or, \(-8 = a\)
\(\therefore a = -8\) (Ans.)"},{"label":"B","letter":"B","text":"If Q = 0, then show that, \(x + y + z = 0\) or \(x = y = z\).","marks":4,"answer":"Given, \(Q = x^3 + y^3 + z^3 - 3xyz = 0\)
or, \((x + y)^3 - 3xy(x + y) + z^3 - 3xyz = 0\)
or, \((x + y)^3 + z^3 - 3xy(x + y + z) = 0\)
or, \((x + y + z)\{(x + y)^2 - (x + y)z + z^2\} - 3xy(x + y + z) = 0\)
or, \((x + y + z)(x^2 + 2xy + y^2 - xz - yz + z^2 - 3xy) = 0\)
or, \((x + y + z)(x^2 + y^2 + z^2 - xy - yz - zx) = 0\)
or, \(\frac{1}{2}(x + y + z)\{2x^2 + 2y^2 + 2z^2 - 2xy - 2yz - 2zx\} = 0\)
or, \(\frac{1}{2}(x + y + z)\{(x - y)^2 + (y - z)^2 + (z - x)^2\} = 0\)
\(\therefore\) Either \(x + y + z = 0\)
or \((x - y)^2 + (y - z)^2 + (z - x)^2 = 0\)
Since sum of squares is zero, each term must be zero:
\(x - y = 0 \Rightarrow x = y\)
\(y - z = 0 \Rightarrow y = z\)
\(z - x = 0 \Rightarrow z = x\)
\(\therefore x = y = z\)
So, \(x + y + z = 0\) or \(x = y = z\) (Showed)"},{"label":"C","letter":"C","text":"Express \(\frac{x^3}{P(x)}\) into partial fraction.","marks":4,"answer":"Given, \(P(x) = x^3 + 4x^2 + x - 6\)
\(= x^3 + 2x^2 + 2x^2 + 4x - 3x - 6\)
\(= x^2(x + 2) + 2x(x + 2) - 3(x + 2)\)
\(= (x + 2)(x^2 + 2x - 3)\)
\(= (x + 2)(x^2 + 3x - x - 3)\)
\(= (x + 2)(x + 3)(x - 1)\)
\(\therefore \frac{x^3}{P(x)} = \frac{x^3}{(x + 2)(x + 3)(x - 1)}\)
Since degree of numerator equals degree of denominator, we write:
Let \(\frac{x^3}{(x + 2)(x + 3)(x - 1)} = 1 + \frac{A}{x + 2} + \frac{B}{x + 3} + \frac{C}{x - 1}\) ... (i)
Multiplying both sides by \((x + 2)(x + 3)(x - 1)\),
\(x^3 = (x + 2)(x + 3)(x - 1) + A(x + 3)(x - 1) + B(x + 2)(x - 1) + C(x + 2)(x + 3)\) ... (ii)
Putting \(x = -2\) in (ii),
\((-2)^3 = A(-2 + 3)(-2 - 1)\)
or, \(-8 = A(1)(-3) \Rightarrow A = \frac{8}{3}\)
Putting \(x = -3\) in (ii),
\((-3)^3 = B(-3 + 2)(-3 - 1)\)
or, \(-27 = B(-1)(-4) \Rightarrow B = -\frac{27}{4}\)
Putting \(x = 1\) in (ii),
\((1)^3 = C(1 + 2)(1 + 3)\)
or, \(1 = C(3)(4) \Rightarrow C = \frac{1}{12}\)
Substituting A, B, C in (i):
\(\frac{x^3}{(x + 2)(x + 3)(x - 1)} = 1 + \frac{\frac{8}{3}}{x + 2} + \frac{-\frac{27}{4}}{x + 3} + \frac{\frac{1}{12}}{x - 1}\)
\(= 1 + \frac{8}{3(x + 2)} - \frac{27}{4(x + 3)} + \frac{1}{12(x - 1)}\)
which is the required partial fraction. (Ans.)
---"}]

question: (i) f: R - {5} → R, f(x) = \(\frac{x - 3}{x + 5}\) and P(x) = \(\frac{2x + 4}{(x - 1)(x^2 + 2)}\) Combining Chapters 1 & 2
parts:
[{"label":"A","letter":"A","text":"Find the domain of g(x) = \(\frac{1}{\sqrt{5 - 2x}}\)","marks":2,"answer":"Given, g(x) = \(\frac{1}{\sqrt{5 - 2x}}\)
The function g(x) will be defined if and only if
\(5 - 2x > 0\)
or, \(-2x > -5\)
or, \(2x < 5\)
\(\therefore x < \frac{5}{2}\)
\(\therefore\) Domain of g(x), D_g = \(\{x : x \in \mathbb{R} \text{ and } x < \frac{5}{2}\}\) (Ans.)"},{"label":"B","letter":"B","text":"Verify whether f is an onto function or not.","marks":4,"answer":"Given, f(x) = \(\frac{x - 3}{x + 5}\)
f(x) will be defined if and only if \(x + 5 \neq 0\) or, \(x \neq -5\).
Let, \(y = f(x) \Rightarrow x = f^{-1}(y)\)
Now, \(y = \frac{x - 3}{x + 5}\)
or, \(xy + 5y = x - 3\)
or, \(xy - x = -5y - 3\)
or, \(x(y - 1) = -5y - 3\)
or, \(x = \frac{-5y - 3}{y - 1}\)
\(\therefore f^{-1}(y) = \frac{-5y - 3}{y - 1}\)
\(\therefore f^{-1}(x) = \frac{-5x - 3}{x - 1}\)
f^{-1}(x) will be defined if and only if \(x - 1 \neq 0\) or, \(x \neq 1\).
\(\therefore\) Domain of f^{-1} = Range of f = \(\mathbb{R} - \{1\}\).
But co-domain of f = \(\mathbb{R}\).
\(\therefore\) Range ≠ Co-domain.
So, the function is not an onto function. (Verified)"},{"label":"C","letter":"C","text":"Express P(x) into partial fraction.","marks":4,"answer":"Given, P(x) = \(\frac{2x + 4}{(x - 1)(x^2 + 4)}\)
Let \(\frac{2x + 4}{(x - 1)(x^2 + 4)} = \frac{A}{x - 1} + \frac{Bx + C}{x^2 + 4}\) ... (i)
Multiplying both sides by \((x - 1)(x^2 + 4)\),
\(2x + 4 = A(x^2 + 4) + (Bx + C)(x - 1)\) ... (ii)
Putting \(x = 1\) in (ii),
\(2(1) + 4 = A(1 + 4)\)
or, \(6 = 5A \Rightarrow A = \frac{6}{5}\)
From (ii): \(2x + 4 = Ax^2 + 4A + Bx^2 - Bx + Cx - C\)
or, \(2x + 4 = (A + B)x^2 + (-B + C)x + (4A - C)\) ... (iii)
Equating coefficients:
Coefficient of \(x^2\): \(A + B = 0 \Rightarrow B = -A = -\frac{6}{5}\)
Coefficient of \(x\): \(-B + C = 2 \Rightarrow -(-\frac{6}{5}) + C = 2 \Rightarrow \frac{6}{5} + C = 2 \Rightarrow C = 2 - \frac{6}{5} = \frac{10 - 6}{5} = \frac{4}{5}\)
Substituting A, B, C in (i):
\(\frac{2x + 4}{(x - 1)(x^2 + 4)} = \frac{\frac{6}{5}}{x - 1} + \frac{-\frac{6}{5}x + \frac{4}{5}}{x^2 + 4}\)
\(= \frac{6}{5(x - 1)} + \frac{-6x + 4}{5(x^2 + 4)}\)
\(= \frac{6}{5(x - 1)} - \frac{6x - 4}{5(x^2 + 4)}\)
which is the required partial fraction. (Ans.)
---"}]

question:
(i) F(x) = \(\frac{x}{2x + 3}\)
(ii) G(x) = \(\frac{1}{(x - 1)(x^2 + 9)}\) Combining Chapters 1 & 2
parts:
[{"label":"A","letter":"A","text":"Find the domain of F(x).","marks":2,"answer":"Given, \(F(x) = \frac{x}{2x + 3}\)
F(x) will be defined if and only if \(2x + 3 \neq 0\) or, \(x \neq -\frac{3}{2}\).
\(\therefore\) Domain = \(\mathbb{R} - \left\{-\frac{3}{2}\right\}\) (Ans.)"},{"label":"B","letter":"B","text":"If \(3F^{-1}(x) = x\), find the value of x.","marks":4,"answer":"Let \(y = F(x) = \frac{x}{2x + 3}\)
or, \(2xy + 3y = x\)
or, \(2xy - x = -3y\)
or, \(x(2y - 1) = -3y\)
or, \(x = \frac{-3y}{2y - 1}\)
\(\therefore F^{-1}(y) = \frac{-3y}{2y - 1}\)
\(\therefore F^{-1}(x) = \frac{-3x}{2x - 1}\)
According to the question, \(3F^{-1}(x) = x\)
or, \(3 \cdot \frac{-3x}{2x - 1} = x\)
or, \(\frac{-9x}{2x - 1} = x\)
or, \(-9x = x(2x - 1)\)
or, \(-9x = 2x^2 - x\)
or, \(2x^2 + 8x = 0\)
or, \(2x(x + 4) = 0\)
\(\therefore\) Either \(2x = 0 \Rightarrow x = 0\), or \(x + 4 = 0 \Rightarrow x = -4\)
\(\therefore\) Required values of \(x = 0, -4\) (Ans.)"},{"label":"C","letter":"C","text":"Express \((x^2 - 4x - 7)G(x)\) into partial fraction.","marks":4,"answer":"Given, \(G(x) = \frac{1}{(x - 1)(x^2 + 9)}\)
Given expression = \((x^2 - 4x - 7) G(x) = \frac{x^2 - 4x - 7}{(x - 1)(x^2 + 9)}\)
Let \(\frac{x^2 - 4x - 7}{(x - 1)(x^2 + 9)} = \frac{A}{x - 1} + \frac{Bx + C}{x^2 + 9}\) ... (i)
Multiplying both sides by \((x - 1)(x^2 + 9)\),
\(x^2 - 4x - 7 = A(x^2 + 9) + (Bx + C)(x - 1)\) ... (ii)
Putting \(x = 1\) in (ii),
\(1 - 4 - 7 = A(1 + 9)\)
or, \(-10 = 10A \Rightarrow A = -1\)
From (ii): \(x^2 - 4x - 7 = Ax^2 + 9A + Bx^2 - Bx + Cx - C\)
\(= (A + B)x^2 + (-B + C)x + (9A - C)\) ... (iii)
Equating coefficients:
Coefficient of \(x^2\): \(A + B = 1 \Rightarrow -1 + B = 1 \Rightarrow B = 2\)
Coefficient of \(x\): \(-B + C = -4 \Rightarrow -2 + C = -4 \Rightarrow C = -2\)
Substituting A, B, C in (i):
\(\frac{x^2 - 4x - 7}{(x - 1)(x^2 + 9)} = \frac{-1}{x - 1} + \frac{2x - 2}{x^2 + 9}\)
which is the required partial fraction. (Ans.)
---"}]

subject: Higher Mathematics
question: P(x) = \(4x^3 - 4Cx^2 - \frac{C}{3}x + C\) is a polynomial function of x, where C is a constant.
parts:
[{"label":"A","letter":"A","text":"What is the value of f(-1) and f(2) where f(x) = \(4x^3 - 4x^2 - 9x + 9\)?","marks":2,"answer":"\(f(x) = 4x^3 - 4x^2 - 9x + 9\)
\(f(-1) = 4(-1)^3 - 4(-1)^2 - 9(-1) + 9 = -4 - 4 + 9 + 9 = 10\)
\(f(2) = 4(2)^3 - 4(2)^2 - 9(2) + 9 = 32 - 16 - 18 + 9 = 7\) (Ans.)"},{"label":"B","letter":"B","text":"What is the value of C for which P(x) is divisible by (2x - 1)? Also find the other factors of P(x).","marks":4,"answer":"\(P(x) = 4x^3 - 4Cx^2 - \frac{C}{3}x + C\)
If divisible by \((2x - 1)\), then \(P\left(\frac{1}{2}\right) = 0\)
\(\therefore 4\left(\frac{1}{2}\right)^3 - 4C\left(\frac{1}{2}\right)^2 - \frac{C}{3}\left(\frac{1}{2}\right) + C = 0\)
or, \(4 \cdot \frac{1}{8} - 4C \cdot \frac{1}{4} - \frac{C}{6} + C = 0\)
or, \(\frac{1}{2} - C - \frac{C}{6} + C = 0\)
or, \(\frac{1}{2} - \frac{C}{6} = 0\)
or, \(\frac{C}{6} = \frac{1}{2} \Rightarrow C = 3\)
For \(C = 3\), \(P(x) = 4x^3 - 12x^2 - x + 3\)
Now, since \((2x - 1)\) is a factor, divide \(P(x)\) by \((2x - 1)\):
Using synthetic division or factor theorem:
\(P(x) = (2x - 1)(2x^2 - 5x - 3) = (2x - 1)(2x + 1)(x - 3)\) (Ans.)"},{"label":"C","letter":"C","text":"For C = 3, express \(\frac{P(1)}{P(x)}\) into partial fraction.","marks":4,"answer":"For \(C = 3\), \(P(x) = 4x^3 - 12x^2 - x + 3 = (2x - 1)(2x + 1)(x - 3)\)
\(P(1) = 4(1)^3 - 12(1)^2 - 1 + 3 = 4 - 12 - 1 + 3 = -6\)
\(\therefore \frac{P(1)}{P(x)} = \frac{-6}{(2x - 1)(2x + 1)(x - 3)}\)
Let \(\frac{-6}{(2x - 1)(2x + 1)(x - 3)} = \frac{A}{2x - 1} + \frac{B}{2x + 1} + \frac{C}{x - 3}\) ... (i)
Multiplying both sides by \((2x - 1)(2x + 1)(x - 3)\),
\(-6 = A(2x + 1)(x - 3) + B(2x - 1)(x - 3) + C(2x - 1)(2x + 1)\) ... (ii)
Putting \(x = \frac{1}{2}\) in (ii),
\(-6 = A\left(2 \cdot \frac{1}{2} + 1\right)\left(\frac{1}{2} - 3\right)\)
or, \(-6 = A(2)\left(-\frac{5}{2}\right) \Rightarrow -6 = -5A \Rightarrow A = \frac{6}{5}\)
Putting \(x = -\frac{1}{2}\) in (ii),
\(-6 = B\left(2 \cdot -\frac{1}{2} - 1\right)\left(-\frac{1}{2} - 3\right)\)
or, \(-6 = B(-2)\left(-\frac{7}{2}\right) \Rightarrow -6 = 7B \Rightarrow B = -\frac{6}{7}\)
Putting \(x = 3\) in (ii),
\(-6 = C(2 \cdot 3 - 1)(2 \cdot 3 + 1)\)
or, \(-6 = C(5)(7) \Rightarrow -6 = 35C \Rightarrow C = -\frac{6}{35}\)
Substituting in (i):
\(\frac{-6}{(2x - 1)(2x + 1)(x - 3)} = \frac{\frac{6}{5}}{2x - 1} + \frac{-\frac{6}{7}}{2x + 1} + \frac{-\frac{6}{35}}{x - 3}\)
\(= \frac{6}{5(2x - 1)} - \frac{6}{7(2x + 1)} - \frac{6}{35(x - 3)}\) (Ans.)
---"}]

parts:
[{"label":"A","letter":"A","text":"Show that, \((x + 2)\) is a factor of P(x).","marks":2,"answer":"Given, \(P(x) = x^3 + 4x^2 + x - 6\)
\(P(-2) = (-2)^3 + 4(-2)^2 + (-2) - 6\)
\(= -8 + 16 - 2 - 6 = 0\)
\(\therefore (x + 2)\) is a factor of P(x) (Showed)"},{"label":"B","letter":"B","text":"If both \((x - m)\) and \((x - n)\) are the factors of P(x), prove that, \(m^2 + mn + n^2 + 4m + 4n + 1 = 0\), where \(m \neq n\).","marks":4,"answer":"Since \((x - m)\) and \((x - n)\) are factors, \(P(m) = 0\) and \(P(n) = 0\).
\(\therefore P(m) = P(n) = 0\)
Given \(P(x) = x^3 + 4x^2 + x - 6\)
So, \(m^3 + 4m^2 + m - 6 = n^3 + 4n^2 + n - 6\)
or, \(m^3 - n^3 + 4(m^2 - n^2) + (m - n) = 0\)
or, \((m - n)(m^2 + mn + n^2) + 4(m - n)(m + n) + (m - n) = 0\)
or, \((m - n)[m^2 + mn + n^2 + 4(m + n) + 1] = 0\)
Since \(m \neq n\), \(m - n \neq 0\), so:
\(m^2 + mn + n^2 + 4m + 4n + 1 = 0\) (Proved)"},{"label":"C","letter":"C","text":"Express \(\frac{x^3}{P(x)}\) as partial fraction.","marks":4,"answer":"From earlier, \(P(x) = (x + 2)(x + 3)(x - 1)\)
\(\frac{x^3}{P(x)} = \frac{x^3}{(x + 2)(x + 3)(x - 1)}\)
Since degree of numerator equals degree of denominator:
Let \(\frac{x^3}{(x + 2)(x + 3)(x - 1)} = 1 + \frac{A}{x + 2} + \frac{B}{x + 3} + \frac{C}{x - 1}\) ... (i)
Multiplying both sides by \((x + 2)(x + 3)(x - 1)\),
\(x^3 = (x + 2)(x + 3)(x - 1) + A(x + 3)(x - 1) + B(x + 2)(x - 1) + C(x + 2)(x + 3)\) ... (ii)
Putting \(x = -2\):
\((-2)^3 = A(-2 + 3)(-2 - 1) \Rightarrow -8 = A(1)(-3) \Rightarrow A = \frac{8}{3}\)
Putting \(x = -3\):
\((-3)^3 = B(-3 + 2)(-3 - 1) \Rightarrow -27 = B(-1)(-4) \Rightarrow B = -\frac{27}{4}\)
Putting \(x = 1\):
\(1^3 = C(1 + 2)(1 + 3) \Rightarrow 1 = C(3)(4) \Rightarrow C = \frac{1}{12}\)
Substituting in (i):
\(\frac{x^3}{(x + 2)(x + 3)(x - 1)} = 1 + \frac{8}{3(x + 2)} - \frac{27}{4(x + 3)} + \frac{1}{12(x - 1)}\) (Ans.)
---"}]

subject: Higher Mathematics
question:
(i) f(x) = \(\sqrt{2 - 5x}\)
(ii) g(x) = \(x^3 - x^2 - 2x\). Combining Chapters 1 & 2
parts:
[{"label":"A","letter":"A","text":"Determine the domain of f(x).","marks":2,"answer":"Given, f(x) = \(\sqrt{2 - 5x}\)
The function f(x) will be defined if and only if
\(2 - 5x \geq 0\)
or, \(-5x \geq -2\)
or, \(5x \leq 2\)
\(\therefore x \leq \frac{2}{5}\)
\(\therefore\) Domain, \(D_f = \{x : x \in \mathbb{R} \text{ and } x \leq \frac{2}{5}\}\) (Ans.)"},{"label":"B","letter":"B","text":"Find the value of \(f^{-1}(-2)\) by determining \(f^{-1}(x)\).","marks":4,"answer":"Given, f(x) = \(\sqrt{2 - 5x}\)
Let \(y = f(x) = \sqrt{2 - 5x}\)
or, \(y^2 = 2 - 5x\)
or, \(5x = 2 - y^2\)
or, \(x = \frac{2 - y^2}{5}\)
\(\therefore f^{-1}(y) = \frac{2 - y^2}{5}\)
\(\therefore f^{-1}(x) = \frac{2 - x^2}{5}\)
Now, \(f^{-1}(-2) = \frac{2 - (-2)^2}{5} = \frac{2 - 4}{5} = \frac{-2}{5}\) (Ans.)"},{"label":"C","letter":"C","text":"Express \(\frac{5}{g(x)}\) into partial fractions.","marks":4,"answer":"Given, \(g(x) = x^3 - x^2 - 2x\)
\(= x(x^2 - x - 2)\)
\(= x(x^2 - 2x + x - 2)\)
\(= x[x(x - 2) + 1(x - 2)]\)
\(= x(x - 2)(x + 1)\)
\(\therefore \frac{5}{g(x)} = \frac{5}{x(x - 2)(x + 1)}\)
Let \(\frac{5}{x(x - 2)(x + 1)} = \frac{A}{x} + \frac{B}{x - 2} + \frac{C}{x + 1}\) ... (i)
Multiplying both sides by \(x(x - 2)(x + 1)\),
\(5 = A(x - 2)(x + 1) + Bx(x + 1) + Cx(x - 2)\) ... (ii)
Putting \(x = 2\) in (ii),
\(5 = B \cdot 2(2 + 1)\)
or, \(5 = 6B \Rightarrow B = \frac{5}{6}\)
Putting \(x = 0\) in (ii),
\(5 = A(0 - 2)(0 + 1)\)
or, \(5 = -2A \Rightarrow A = -\frac{5}{2}\)
Putting \(x = -1\) in (ii),
\(5 = C(-1)(-1 - 2)\)
or, \(5 = 3C \Rightarrow C = \frac{5}{3}\)
Substituting A, B, C in (i):
\(\frac{5}{x(x - 2)(x + 1)} = \frac{-\frac{5}{2}}{x} + \frac{\frac{5}{6}}{x - 2} + \frac{\frac{5}{3}}{x + 1}\)
\(= -\frac{5}{2x} + \frac{5}{6(x - 2)} + \frac{5}{3(x + 1)}\)
which is the required partial fraction. (Ans.)
---"}]

question:

parts:
[{"label":"A","letter":"A","text":"Find the constant term of \(f(x)\) as the standard form of polynomial.","marks":2,"answer":"\(f(x) = ax^3 + 28x^2 + 14x - (a + 7)\)
In standard form: \(f(x) = ax^3 + 28x^2 + 14x - (a + 7)\)
Constant term = \(-(a + 7)\) (Ans.)"},{"label":"B","letter":"B","text":"If \((2x - 1)\) is a factor of \(f(x)\), then find the value of a.","marks":2,"answer":"If \((2x - 1)\) is a factor, then \(f\left(\frac{1}{2}\right) = 0\)

Compare coefficient of x^2: 0 = A + B ⇒ B = 5/9.
Thus L(x) = -\(\frac{5}{9x} + \frac{5}{9(x-3)} + \frac{4}{3(x-3)^2}\) (Ans.)
